checks.finding: Every REQ-001..REQ-008 goal is decomposed into concrete, fixture-bound acceptance criteria (e.g. REQ-002's sixteen-row Block taxonomy is exhaustively tested by AC-010, one independently-triggerable fixture per diagnostic id, plus one clean-negative fixture; REQ-005's determinism claim is tested by AC-022/AC-023/AC-024/AC-025). No in-scope requirement lacks an observable/measurable validation path.

REQ-001 through REQ-008 each have at least one mapped AC (REQ-001: AC-001-009/038/043/052/054; REQ-002: AC-010-015/039-041/047-049/055; REQ-003: AC-015/016/042; REQ-004: AC-017-021/044/050/051/054/056; REQ-005: AC-022-025/045; REQ-006: AC-026-028/045; REQ-007: AC-029-032/042/046/053; REQ-008: AC-033/034). The round-2 GOAL-AC-TRACE finding is closed: AC-055 (requirements.md:821) and AC-056 (requirements.md:822) are now present in requirements.md's own Acceptance Criteria table, matching acceptance-tests.md's AC-055/AC-056 (lines 94-95) in substance.

Acceptance criteria describe concrete externally observable outcomes (byte-identical output fixtures, schema-validation pass/fail, specific exit codes, exact array cardinalities, file-existence/non-existence after a Block). Even the four design-content-review ACs (AC-029-032, REQ-007) cite exact requirements.md/design.md locations and are recorded as 'Confirmed present' in the Spec-Authoring-Time Manual Review Record (acceptance-tests.md:97-124), which is an acceptable verification mechanism per calibration's Phase 1 scope.

Non-goals (requirements.md:686-738) explicitly excludes building the Resolver scripts themselves, editing any Epic A1-A4 contract file, adding a Registry field, re-specifying check-component-coverage's Fail conditions, implementing compare-facet-manifest-staleness's caller, computing the full effective-enforcement formula, editing plugins/**, authoring a new ADR, and running review gates against this package. AC-032 additionally locks the plugins/** boundary via git-diff inspection.

Security Boundaries (requirements.md:1085-1144) fixes write-path constraints, approval-sidecar exclusion, and single-writer assumption; Dependencies (94-210) names the Epic A2 Registry-schema migration path with an explicit owner and migration statement ('existing Registry instances remain valid until a Capability author opts into the new field'); Assumptions (1146-1171) states the protected-suffix-reservation timing constraint and its fallback.

Risks (requirements.md:1195-1280) names six high-risk claims, each paired with a validation surface: the Lite-track-Blocked risk is covered by REQ-002's tested lite-check-source-undefined Block condition (AC-010/AC-009); the new multi-component-matching/facet-aggregation orchestration decisions are explicitly framed as spec-review-evaluable ('that divergence surfaces as a spec-review finding on this package... precisely so spec-review can evaluate them before implementation begins'); the anchor-fingerprint drift risk is covered by AC-053's fixture; the protected-suffix-timing risk is covered by the Assumptions section's re-verification requirement.
